tei:div.tei:p: /jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sgom pa'i rim pa bzhugs so//

ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgom lung nyan nas nyams su blang snyam pa mdzod/ de yang gnas dben par rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro zhing*/ sems dpa'i dkyil mo krung gis 'dug skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems can thams cad kyi don du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed byas nas ngag tu/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og ma na shel dkar gyi phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad 'dren pa'i tshul du 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon 'og mas padma dkar po'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lha'i dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs kyis bklubs la/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i smad kyi cha la hūm̐/ dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hrīḥdakar po la yi ge drug ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan zhing bstod nas/ hrīḥyi mtha' mar oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas bskor du 'khor ba la dmigs te bzlas pa'o// de'i dus su phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad ri bo po ta la ru bsgoms shing*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su bsgoms te/ yi ge drug pa'i sgra 'u ru ru 'don par bsam zhing*/ sngar ltar mchod bstod dang yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bzod par gsol/ dge rtsa bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim pa'i mos pa bya/ de nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug pa la sogs pa nyams su len par mdzod/ ces bdag 'khor ma brjod do// zhes pa 'di yang spo bo dbon po gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen gyis sbyar ba'o// maṅgalaṃ/
